checks.assessment: The lemma only needs a locally bounded psh background on a domain in any dimension.
max(u_j,b-1) is psh and lies between b-1 and b since u_j<=b.
Its difference from b is at most that of u_j on every compact.
On a ball compactly contained in the domain, R=osc_B b+1 is finite and independent of j.
The fixed local range and capacity convergence give local vague convergence of top measures.
Normalize v_j on B to the interval[0,1], yielding R^n cap for any Borel subset of B-prime.
E_j defined by <= has capacity tending to zero because it lies in the >1/2 difference set.
Both psh functions are plurifine continuous; the strict comparison set is plurifine open and Borel.
Restricted good-set measures agree and discarded u_j bad-set measure is nonnegative.
The truncation bad-set mass tends to zero against each fixed nonnegative compact test.
A finite nonnegative partition of unity on concentric ball covers preserves the lower inequalities.
Vague subsequential convergence against nonnegative Cc tests gives the Radon measure order.
Full clusters in the actual metrizable vague topology are closed, without compactness of measure space.
Construction uses b globally bounded on a bounded Euclidean domain and n>=2.
A dense sequence in a closed subset can be concatenated with each member appearing arbitrarily late.
Closedness excludes any subsequential limit outside F.
mu_b+j delta_a has no vague convergent subsequence by one nonnegative compact test.
nu_j>=mu_b makes each difference a positive Radon measure, including possibly infinite total mass.
Only finite mass on a compact neighborhood of first j tests is used.
Use the finite-test construction separately for each moving excess, not the fixed-target limit assertion.
tau=t=1/(jN_j) bounds total addition errors and all norms independently of N_j.
u_j=b gives norm zero and only the finite-test atomic approximation error.
Each one-atom perturbation satisfies all finite p bounds with one choice; their sums are C_Omega,p/j.
The sum of smooth negative psh perturbations preserves u_j<=b.
Each finite sum is globally bounded; no common lower bound across j is asserted.
Summed normalized psh-test integrals are C_B-prime,B,Omega/j and Markov gives every threshold.
The direct sums are smooth if b is smooth; no Richberg-based continuous-background extension asserted.
First j coordinates give <=2/j and the remaining series <=2^-j.
Metric proximity transfers fixed limits on corresponding subsequences, without signed Cc convergence for moving masses.
b=|z|^2-1 on the unit ball has a positive nonzero top measure, so {0} is excluded by the proved order.
L1 convergence forces distributional Hessian convergence and hence vague positive measure convergence; the only full cluster is{mu_b}.
Theorem A/C use general L1 approximation; the new below-background capacity classification is a separately proved stronger convergence regime.
No AWNW truncation, maximal approximation, Richberg/domain theorem or new Popovici input is imported.
